_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and, being the wider of the two (D7), sizes the one sensor — which is also the audience interaction.ambient fans out to. The pre-merge aggroRadius 1.0 stayed as authored but no longer governs anything: under D21 leaving talk range now ENDS a conversation, and 1.0 leaves less standing room than the two bodies take up (L26). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. The Z2 front captain: Vanguard at cL15, the deepest-gated teaching in the world.
name: FrontCaptain

lines: You might just have a chance at the Orc Commander. He's in his camp in the west.
But steel will not touch him while his war banners stand. Destroy his banners first — then bring him down.

options.blockedLine: Careful, the Orc assault camp lies just south of here. This is no place for you yet — and when it is, remember: no blade touches the Orc Commander while his war banners stand.

grants.line: You look strong! We could use your help in the war. Take this.
